We are concerned instead with the massive proliferation of relationships between humans and AI and how this affects our wellbeing and societal fabrics. Billions of conversations between people and AI are accumulating into relationships. This ranges children talking to toys, adults with AI companions, or elderly people engaging with healthcare assistants. We measure real conversations and relationships, and the trajectories of risks involved, and publish what we find, so platforms (and society) can decide when and how to act. We build ML models, track incidents, analyze new regulations, and run evaluations constantly on both raw LLMs and deployed AI. We believe you cannot foster safe and aligned AI without proprer governance and scrutiny into AI as it is truly deployed and productized. The eval space in AI is currently heavily oriented to raw LLM evals unfortuntely. We seek to change that. We seek to hold AI labs and products to account for the harms they produce. Our mission is malleable and always changing, and we search for people who seek to help define that. The Social Comms role : We are doing quite a lot but are very limited on social-and-community-driving capacity. The incidents and regulations we track, the whitepapers, plus our evaluations, are all lacking our commentary and voice. We want to increase our social media presence significantly and start to be a more active participant in the global conversation around AI safety and alignment. As our social-comms person you'd take artifacts and research we produce and weave them into a consistent, human presence on the prevalent social channels: deciding what gets posted, writing it, engaging with the researchers, journalists, builders and policymakers already wrestling with these questions. jobs.title: Why do you want this new job
jobs.description: No matter which side of the table youâve sat during interviews, youâve probably heard this question: âWhy do you want this new job?â In the recent past, Iâve interviewed a few candidates and heard the following answers so far: Iâm not learning much on the current job after itâs been 2-4 years. Iâm looking for something that offers better work-life balance. Iâm not really looking for a job. The recruiters got in touch and I thought Iâd discuss. Iâm looking for more challenging work. All of the above are valid answers. I think thereâs another perfectly valid answer that candidates seldom mention probably due to the gravity of the interview room situation. Iâve interviewed over a hundred candidates across different companies and am yet to find anyone that mentions: I am not happy with my current salary and benefits compared to my skills Back to topic of answers. So, when someone answers that they are not learning new things on the job, obviously, youâd be curios to know why and how they have tried to change things. Unfortunately, most candidates simply mention that they are doing repeat work and thereâs not much to learn doing the same thing over and over again. This is where I start feeling a little uneasy. However, I understand that itâs a true statement. If youâre in a similar situation, hereâs some suggestion: read books, and write code based on what youâve read. Then, you can tell a much convincing story that, Iâve forced myself to learn new things and hereâs some proof, but I really want to apply the newly learned skills outside the scope of the âhello worldâ skills. About work-life balance, I totally hear you. And if your current job doesnât suit what you need out of your life, itâs a perfectly valid reason to look for new opportunities. However, make sure youâre able to clearly set the expectation with your potential employer about what work-life balance means for you. For example, if you canât work over 40 hours a week, or must work from home one-two days a week, itâs best to discuss this even before an interview starts to ensure youâre a good match with the employer. If you showed up at in interview just because a recruiter got in touch, Iâd say introspect first. Itâs possible that on our subconcious mind you have expectations that the potential of the new job offers you something that you donât get at the current job. So, instead of a passive asnwer that the you simply acted based on the recruiterâs invite, itâs much convincing to see if you can lay down one or two things that you expect from the new job that you donât get at the current job. About looking for more challenge, it sounds like a cliche unless you can share examples of work that is of challenging to you. May be you like the challenge of using more complicated algorithms, may be you like dealing with a lot of data, may be you like supporting production emergencies, but thereâs gotta be something that you can explicitly mention as challenging. It helps employers to understand if theyâre able to provide you with enough challenge on the job. Finally, if youâre looking for a new job because the current job isnât paying upto the level of your skills and contributions, make sure to communicate it clearly as well. With salaries and benefits, I find it much easier to work with people that know the actual $ figure thatâll make them happy instead of beating around the bush to create confusions all around. Just be confident and tell what makes you happy. If the employer can afford it, most likely theyâll want to get you onboard as a happy employee. If they canât afford it, theyâll do their best. The key here is to be explicit about what you want and be sure and confident about it. In a nutshell, when you walk into an interview itâs yours to lose. The potential employer is investing their time and resources and would rather have you hired than having to interview other candidates. A

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager - Digital Communications (all genders)
jobs.description: Über ]init[ Du möchtest die Gesellschaft von morgen mitgestalten? Dann bist du bei ]init[ richtig. Denn unsere digitalen Lösungen sind für Menschen gemacht und haben gesellschaftliche Relevanz. Klingt spannend? Dann steig ein und arbeite gemeinsam mit über 1.400 ]init[s in interdisziplinären Teams an unseren sieben Standorten – oder flexibel von überall in Deutschland aus. Deine Mission bei ]init[ Du möchtest digitale Projekte nicht nur verwalten, sondern aktiv gestalten und gemeinsam mit deinen Kund:innen weiterentwickeln? Als Senior Project Manager (all genders) übernimmst du Verantwortung für anspruchsvolle digitale Kommunikationsprojekte – mit einem besonderen Schwerpunkt auf CMS-basierten Informationsangeboten und Websites sowie deren Weiterentwicklung und Betrieb. Dabei bewegst du dich an der Schnittstelle von Technologie, digitaler Kommunikationsberatung, Kreation und Content. Dabei verbindest du eine sichere Steuerung digitaler Umsetzungsprojekte mit einem guten Gespür für die Bedarfe deiner Kund:innen. Du erkennst Entwicklungspotenziale, bringst die richtigen Expert:innen zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass aus Ideen erfolgreiche digitale Lösungen in der Umsetzung werden. Das gibt es zu tun Du steuerst anspruchsvolle digitale Umsetzungsprojekte und hältst Scope, Budget, Qualität und Timing sicher auf Kurs. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf digitalen Kommunikationsprojekten – insbesondere CMS-basierten Informationsangeboten und Websites sowie deren Weiterentwicklung und Betrieb. Dabei arbeitest du mit Teams aus Technologie, digitaler Kommunikationsberatung, Kreation, Content und UX zusammen. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Kund:innen und interdisziplinären Projektteams zusammen, verstehst Anforderungen und Herausforderungen und übersetzt sie in konkrete Projektziele und Lösungen. Für dich endet Projektmanagement nicht mit der erfolgreichen Delivery: Du erkennst neue Bedarfe und Potenziale bei bestehenden Kund:innen und entwickelst Projekte und Kundenbeziehungen gemeinsam mit unseren Fachexpert:innen weiter. Du bringst deine Erfahrung und Projektperspektive in Angebote, Ausschreibungen und Pitches ein. Wenn du hier bereits Erfahrung mitbringst, umso besser – wenn nicht, kannst du dich bei uns gezielt in diesem Bereich weiterentwickeln. Du steuerst unterschiedliche Stakeholder souverän und sorgst auch in komplexen Projektsituationen für Klarheit, Verbindlichkeit und eine gute Zusammenarbeit. Das bringst du mit Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Steuerung digitaler Umsetzungsprojekte – idealerweise rund um Websites, Informationsplattformen oder andere CMS-basierte Lösungen. Du verstehst Projektmanagement nicht als reine Verwaltung, sondern möchtest Projekte, Lösungen und Kundenbeziehungen aktiv mitgestalten und weiterentwickeln. Du hast Freude daran, Kund:innen und ihre Herausforderungen zu verstehen, Potenziale zu erkennen und gemeinsam mit interdisziplinären Teams passende Lösungen zu entwickeln. Du bist sowohl in der Zusammenarbeit mit technischen Teams als auch mit Disziplinen wie Kommunikation, UX, Design, Kreation oder Content sicher unterwegs. Erfahrung in Presales, Business Development, Ausschreibungen oder Angebotserstellung ist ein Plus – aber kein Muss. Ob agil oder klassisch: Du kennst unterschiedliche Projektmethoden und setzt sie passend zur jeweiligen Situation ein. Eine Zertifizierung ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss. Controls, Systems and Process Own process improvement and automation across the function, documenting changes as you build them and using AI and modern workflow tools, including NetSuite, to speed up the close and find efficiencies. Support the group's financial controls and risk framework (RCM): help document key controls, carry out testing, identify gaps, and put together remediation plans. About you You're a qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA or CIMA) with 1-2 years of PQE and a solid grounding in financial reporting and controls, built through practice, industry or a multi-entity environment. The exact route matters less than the instinct for clean, well controlled numbers. jobs.description: Multiverse is the upskilling platform for AI and Tech adoption. We have partnered with 1,500+ companies to deliver a new kind of learning that's transforming today’s workforce. Our upskilling apprenticeships are designed for people of any age and career stage to build critical AI, data, and tech skills. At an increased valuation of $2.1bn, the round makes us Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn. But we aren’t stopping there. With a strong operational footprint and 800+ employees, we have ambitious plans to continue scaling. We’re building a world where tech skills unlock people’s potential and output. Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era. The Opportunity It's an incredible time to join Multiverse as Director of Enterprise Technology, as we scale from Series E toward IPO. Every stage of that journey raises the bar on what "good" IT looks like: more employees, more auditors, more systems, more scrutiny — and zero tolerance for the operation falling over. We're looking for a Director of Enterprise Technology to own IT end-to-end: two connected halves of the function , the day-to-day running of IT services across the business, and the delivery of the systems and platform changes that will carry us through IPO and beyond. This is not a "keep the lights on" role split from a "build the future" role — it's one leader accountable for both, because at this stage of growth they have to move in lockstep. You'll be the most senior IT voice in the business, setting the strategy as well as running the operation. This role needs an AI-native leader . Not someone who bolts AI onto existing ways of working, but someone who sees automation and AI as the engine of the team — the thing that lets a lean function support a scaling business without just adding headcount, and that turns IT from a cost centre into a genuine driver of strategic business outcomes. The Mission: Multiverse is reshaping the future of workforce development. As we scale headcount, geographies, and compliance obligations on the way to IPO, IT has to go from "good enough for a fast-growing startup" to "resilient, auditable, and scalable for a public company" — without ever compromising the experience our 1,000+ employees get day to day. The Environment: You'll sit at the centre of a small, high-trust, fully in-house IT function, with full ownership of the IT budget, tooling strategy, and roadmap. You'll represent IT to the exec team and, increasingly, to auditors and the board as we approach IPO. You'll have the autonomy to decide how your team's time and the IT budget are split across your two remits, and the seniority to make the case for more of either when the business needs it. Having recently launched in New York City, we’re expanding rapidly across the US and EMEA. If you take pride in your craft and want to help shape the next chapter of our growth, we'd love to hear from you.</p></div><h3><strong>About The Role</strong></h3> <p>Our Marketplace team builds the models and algorithms that balance supply and demand, optimising pricing and matching to ensure chauffeurs earn and passengers aren't left waiting.</p> <p>We’re looking for a Mid/Senior Backend Engineer to join a team that keeps frameworks lean and focuses on what matters: clean, maintainable code, shipped fast with TDD, DDD, and continuous integration and delivery.</p> <p>We are a Go shop, and while we’re busy migrating away from our Ruby monolith, our stack includes PostgreSQL, MongoDB, RabbitMQ, Redis, gRPC, and Thrift. jobs.description: Meet DeepL DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation. Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures. Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination. What sets us apart What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected. When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture. What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL on LinkedIn , Instagram , and our Blog . Meet the team behind this journey DeepL is not just a translation tool; we are building the Operating System for Global Communication . We are the rare AI company that builds the entire stack in-house: from training next-gen LLMs on our own NVIDIA DGX SuperPODs to delivering real-time Language AI to over 300 million users and 200,000+ businesses globally. You will join DeepL Voice , the team defining the art of the possible for real-time interpretation. While our Translation engine conquered text, Voice is conquering the physical world. We are building the "Universal Translator"; enabling fluid, real-time conversations for frontline workers, global meetings, and enterprise teams. This is a 0-to-1 engineering environment. We successfully launched our first customer-facing features in late 2024, but we are just getting started. We are tackling the hardest problems in AI interaction: How do you eliminate the "flickering" effect of unstable transcripts? How do you chain chunked inference to achieve sub-millisecond latency? How do you deliver a seamless audio stream that feels natural, not robotic?. You will work in a dynamic, cross-functional squad alongside Researchers, Product Managers, and Designers. We are not just wrapping an API; we are building the proprietary models, the streaming architecture, and the user interfaces that allow the world to speak without barriers. Your responsibilities A "0-to-1" Builder Mindset: You thrive in ambiguity. You don't need a roadmap to build; you need a problem. You are comfortable prototyping a new feature in the morning and refactoring it for scale in the afternoon. Product Obsession: You care about the flow of the conversation. You understand that "99% accuracy" means nothing if the audio arrives 3 seconds late. You optimize for the human experience. Ship End-to-End Features: Build and deploy impactful features across the entire stack, from high-performance frontend UIs to streaming audio services on the backend and AI inference integration. Tackle Real-Time Complexity: Debug and resolve challenging edge cases unique to real-time communication, including sub-second latency spikes, transcript flicker, audio glitches, and unstable network environments. jobs.description: About Pleo Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together. About the role We’re looking for a Deputy Head of Financial Crime to join our financial Crime Operations team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help safeguard the firm against financial crime risks, lead critical remediation initiatives, and drive control enhancements as part of our Financial Crime Operations team as we scale our business spend management platform. If you're excited about building robust, future-proofed compliance frameworks and leading high-performing operational teams and are passionate about financial crime prevention and regulatory excellence, then this is the opportunity for you! Who you’ll be working with and reporting to You’ll report to the Associate Director of Financial Crime Operations and work closely with teams in Compliance, Risk, Legal, Operations, and Product. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to mitigating AML, CTF, Sanctions, ABC, and Fraud risks while supporting sustainable business growth. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across the wider organisation, external auditors, and regulatory bodies to ensure success. What you’ll be doing As a Deputy Head of Financial Crime, you will: Drive Compliance oversight and quality assurance: Oversee day to day financial crime reports, disclosures, risk assessments sign-off, and regulatory outputs while monitoring metrics and KPIs to address emerging risks and operational bottlenecks. Lead Complex Remediation & Projects : Act as the primary lead for financial crime remediation programs, regulatory look-backs, control enhancements, and tech integrations from scoping through to execution and root-cause analysis. Provide Strategic Leadership Coverage: Deputise for the Associate Director of Financial Crime Operations during absences, representing the function at executive committees, board meetings, and in regulatory engagements. Direct Team Leadership & Capability Building: Directly lead, coach, and empower the FinCrime Operations team, driving resource planning, talent development, and a high-performing, accountable culture. Foster Cross-Functional & Regulatory Relationships: Work closely with internal Risk, Legal, and Business units, as well as external auditors and regulators, to embed effective financial crime controls across the business. What you bring You’ll thrive in this role if you have: Deep Financial Crime Expertise: Comprehensive knowledge of AML, CTF, Sanctions, ABC, and Fraud frameworks within a 1LOD environment. Strategic & Operational Leadership: Proven track record of direct team management, coaching, resource allocation, and providing trusted counsel to senior stakeholders and boards. Your mission is to build the financial foundation that enables Geordie to scale with confidence. You'll combine rigorous financial management, thoughtful planning and modern systems to give the business the insight, discipline and operational excellence it needs to grow. You'll own financial planning, reporting, forecasting, cash management and financial operations, while working closely with our external finance partners who manage bookkeeping, VAT and other compliance processes. This is not a traditional finance role focused solely on reporting historical numbers. We are looking for someone who enjoys building systems, improving processes and helping leadership make better decisions through high-quality financial analysis and insight. Over time, you'll build an exceptionally efficient finance function that leverages automation and AI wherever practical, allowing the team to scale alongside the business without growing linearly with headcount. Build scalable quote-to-cash processes alongside RevOps and Legal, ensuring strong financial controls as the business grows. Ensure banking, insurance and core financial infrastructure operate effectively. Own financial compliance across our UK and US entities, including tax requirements, R&D claims and coordination with external advisers. Partner with Product as a finance domain expert, providing input into the evolution of Geordie's cost management capabilities. Finance Systems & Automation Help build a modern, highly efficient finance function through thoughtful use of AI, automation and best-in-class financial systems. Ideal Background Experience leading finance within a high-growth B2B SaaS or technology company. Strong background in FP&A, strategic finance or commercial finance, with the ability to build robust financial models and planning processes. jobs.title: Claims Handler – Gadget & Warranty
jobs.description: Turning risk into opportunity Human progress runs on a single trade: risk for opportunity. Every venture worth doing - a new business, a new home, an exciting trip - means accepting the chance it goes wrong. Insurance is what lets us take those chances anyway, and the claim is the moment it either delivers on that promise or fails to. We're rebuilding that moment. ClaimSorted is an AI-native claims solution for insurers and large corporates that resolves claims faster, fairer, and more reliably than the industry ever has. Handle risk that well, and people are free to take on more of it - that's how you push society toward opportunity: not by eliminating risk, but by making recovery so fast and certain it stops being a reason to hold back. We're one of the fastest-growing InsurTechs - scaling 10x YoY, processing hundreds of millions in claims payouts, and backed by the world's leading investors: Y Combinator, Atomico, and Eurazeo. What we are looking for We are looking for a confident, analytical and detail-focused QA & Authorisation Handler to join our Technical Claims Support Team. You will provide a key technical control across our claims operation, completing Quality Assurance reviews and reviewing claim settlements at the authorisation stage . As the final line of defence before a claim settlement is approved , you will be responsible for independently reviewing the claim, evidence, policy coverage and settlement calculation before making the decision to authorise, pass back or escalate . This requires confidence and strong technical judgement. You must be comfortable making decisions, challenging claim assessments where something does not look right and clearly explaining the reasoning behind your decision. The role goes beyond identifying individual errors. You will use findings from QA and authorisations to identify potential financial leakage, recurring handling issues, process and control gaps and emerging trends across the claims operation. You will be comfortable using data to understand where issues are occurring, identify root causes and turn findings into practical improvements to processes, controls, guidance and training. As ClaimSorted works across a range of insurance products and partners, you will need to be adaptable and confident moving between different products, policy wordings, processes and priorities while maintaining consistently high standards. As part of the wider Technical Claims Support Team, you will also support other technical claims activities where required. Responsibilities Review claim settlements at authorisation stage across all ClaimSorted products , acting as the final line of defence before payment is approved. Independently review policy coverage, supporting evidence and settlement calculations, making confident decisions to authorise, pass back or escalate . Complete Quality Assurance reviews across all products , ensuring claims are handled accurately, fairly and in line with policy, partner and internal requirements. Identify and prevent financial leakage , incorrect settlements and other customer or financial risks. Provide clear, constructive and evidence-based feedback to Claims Handlers, confidently challenging decisions where required. Use QA, authorisation and leakage data across products to identify trends, recurring errors, training needs and process or control gaps . Support improvements to claims processes, guidance and controls based on findings and root-cause analysis. Maintain accurate records of decisions and findings while effectively managing and prioritising QA and authorisation workloads. Build and maintain the technical knowledge required to work confidently across all ClaimSorted product lines, partners and processes . Work collaboratively across Claims Operations and the wider Technical Claims Support Team. Skills and Experience Required +2 years experience completing claim authorisations within an insurance claims team is essential , with responsibility

jobs.description: About us People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. It is not. It is a large number of people acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on with tools that have barely changed in decades. Our agents are live in production with some of the leading global forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are expanding the platform deeper into the shipment lifecycle. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality. Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. In person, 4+ days a week in London. We value synchronous communication. Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly. Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues. The role We are building the AI platform for freight forwarding and expanding our product surface, and we are hiring software engineers across product, AI and platform to do it. You will build products that do freight forwarding work alongside our customers' teams, operating across the entire shipment lifecycle. You will work across the stack in Python, TypeScript and React, and directly with customers and founders on what gets built. Everyone here works across the stack, but each engineer has a spike: the area where they set the bar for the team. You spend most of your time where yours is, and lean on your colleagues where theirs are. Product: You build best in class products for the core jobs in freight forwarding, one job at a time. You work as a design partner with our customers to understand the work deeply, turn that understanding into a product they would choose over anything else, and feed what you learn back into the platform everyone builds on. AI: You raise the ceiling on what our AI can do and the floor on how reliably it does it. That spans high volume tasks like classification and extraction and deep workflow tasks that run for hours. You design for performance, reliability, explainability and control, set up the gyms and evals to measure them, and build the harness that runs our agents in all of our products. Platform: You own the foundation every product stands on: the runtime for thousands of concurrent agents and workflows, the way they communicate and scale, the controls for how they access data with permissions that hold, and the observability to see and measure all of it. You ensure the rest of the team can move fast without fear. What we look for A spike, with evidence. Something you have been exceptional at and proof of it. You do not need a freight background, but you need to find messy real-world operations interesting rather than a chore. A health companion and a digital clinic for everyone. We're a small team within Alan, on a mission to redefine the future of care by democratizing access to medical expertise . The Clinic is two crews building one experience: Mo. An intelligent, empathetic, multimodal LLM-based conversational AI assistant able to prescribe, triage, and proactively follow up on care. We kicked off in 2023 and launched Mo to all our French members (1M) in Q1 2026, making it the first safe AI health companion live at scale in Europe. Clinic Platform. The medical services behind the conversation: chat with health practitioners, teleconsultation, and care programs across primary care, mental health, and physiotherapy. Imagine giving every person in the world instant, 24/7 access to personalised medical expertise (through chat, voice, or video) with AI agents working in tandem with real doctors and the health system. That's what we are building 🤖🏥. 🚀 What you'll build and who you'll work with We're building a medical experience that works reliably, safely, and at scale. An AI agent, and the clinic behind it. As their engineering leader, you own: 💬 The team behind the most memorable chatting experience. Hiring, onboarding, honest feedback, and the mix of skills Mo needs as it grows. Talent density is yours to own. ➕ The architecture for Mo's next chapters. More context, new skills, new countries. You guide the calls on our architecture and agentic framework, and you stay close enough to the code to make them well. 🏥 The platform that turns conversations into care. Chat with health practitioners, teleconsultation at national scale, and the tooling doctors and therapists use every day. You drive alignment with the crews and medical teams on the other side, so members get from words to actions. 🛡️ Operational excellence. Mo and teleconsultation are real-time services that have to be live 24/7. Latency, error rates, incident response, and an on-call rotation that doesn't burn people out. If you're excited by the idea of building the future of healthcare, this is the team for you. We're at the start of the journey. jobs.description: Qui sommes-nous ? Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises. La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement. Nous recherchons une Post-doctorante ou un Post-doctorant en apprentissage statistique et IA générative pour rejoindre le département Image Données Signal (IDS) à Télécom Paris. Le sujet spécifique de ce post-doc porte sur la calibration des modèles génératifs pour des données. Dans la littérature, il existe très peu de résultats pratiques et théoriques concernant la capacité des modèles génératifs à fournir, au moment de l'inférence, une mesure d'incertitude sur certaines propriétés ciblées. C’est pourtant un pré-requis pour utiliser l’IA générative dans des domaines critiques tels que la santé ou la sécurité. Le post-doctorat explorera ce nouveau sujet à la lumière des outils récents de calibration en commençant pour la génération de données multivariées et étudiera à terme comment l'approche choisie peut être étendue à des données non euclidiennes telles que les graphes. Vos principales missions seront de : Assurer des missions de recherche dans le domaine de l’Apprentissage statistique Assurer des missions d’encadrement et de tutorat Participer à la notoriété de l’Ecole, de l’Institut Mines-Télécom et de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris Vous êtes titulaire d’un doctorat ou équivalent en apprentissage statistique et maîtrisez l’apprentissage statistique, les modèles génératifs ainsi que les méthodes de quantification de l’incertitude. Une bonne maîtrise de l’anglais est indispensable. Des connaissances en espaces de Hilbert à noyau autoreproduisant et en transport optimal seront appréciées. Vous disposez également d’un bon esprit d’équipe, de qualités relationnelles et pédagogiques et d’une bonne capacité de synthèse. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Vous travaillerez dans un environnement en plein développement, agréable, verdoyant et accessible (notamment pour les personnes en situation de handicap) à seulement 20 km de Paris (RER B et C, proximité des grands axes routiers). Deine Rolle bei June Als Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d) verantwortest du die Produktentwicklung unserer Anwendung für Gärtner*innen. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO. Deine Nutzer sind Gartenbaubetriebe, deren Bedürfnisse Du durch enge Zusammenarbeit mit diesen und weiteren Experten der Branche kennenlernst. jobs.title: Customer Success Manager Grands Comptes - Cabinets comptables H/F (en télétravail depuis Rennes)
jobs.description: Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ? Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance. Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière. Notre vision Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes. Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise. Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients. À propos de Pennylane Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen. En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à : 💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant 💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches! 🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible 🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours 🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France ! Le rôle En tant que Customer Success Manager Key Accounts (CSM KA), tu accompagnes un portefeuille de cabinets partenaires grands comptes (7 à 10 comptes, Top 150) qui déploient Pennylane auprès de leurs équipes et de leurs clients. Ton objectif : maximiser l’adoption, la satisfaction et la rétention, tout en structurant une gouvernance adaptée à des organisations multi-bureaux. Tes responsabilités Piloter la relation au quotidien avec les décisionnaires et équipes projet du cabinet. Construire et animer la gouvernance : COPIL, comités d’adoption, instances de suivi, communauté de relais locaux. Définir et exécuter des plans d’adoption (collaborateurs + clients) fondés sur la donnée. Coordonner l’exécution avec les expert·e·s internes Pennylane (Produit, Support, Ops, Sales, etc.). Anticiper les risques (satisfaction, déploiement, adoption) et mettre en place des plans de remédiation. Contribuer à l’inscription et à l’usage de la PA Pennylane pour centraliser les flux. Ce que tu vas faire concrètement 1) Stratégie d’embarquement clients (TPE/PME) Conseiller les cabinets sur la communication, l’activation et la formation des clients. Aider à intégrer les enjeux de facture électronique dans le plan d’embarquement. Suivre l’exécution post-déploiement et proposer des actions correctives. 2) Adoption et usage côté collaborateurs Mesurer l’usage et identifier les leviers d’amélioration. Mettre en place des plans d’action et en piloter l’exécution. 3) Satisfaction & rétention Maintenir une relation de confiance, cadrer les attentes et délivrer de la valeur. Déployer des plans d’action stratégiques (annuels / semestriels) avec les partenaires. Indicateurs de réussite CSAT sur ton portefeuille. Progression de l’adoption (collaborateurs et clients), suivie en COPIL. Qualité de la gouvernance et autonomie des relais locaux. Réduction des risques et amélioration de la rétention. Profil recherché Expérience de 5 ans minimum : en Custome

Editorial Planning : Contribute to the local editorial calendar and coordinate content production across languages, channels and formats. Social Media Performance Analysis: Monitor and track competitor activities to stay ahead of market trends and industry developments. Digital Marketing Monitor campaigns: launch and manage campaigns on Google Ads and LinkedIn Campaign Manager. Manage email campaigns: send ad-hoc emails and manage automation workflows using HubSpot. Oversee website maintenance: Make sure our website is up-to-date and optimized on Webflow. jobs.title: STAGE Fullstack - Socle générique de mini jeux temps réel (H/F)
jobs.description: Basés en plein cœur de Paris, nous faisons bouger l’industrie des jeux en ligne. Leader du poker et des paris sportifs en France avec 350 000 joueurs et 600 000 parieurs mensuels, nous sommes présents en Espagne, en Allemagne et bientôt en Italie et au Portugal. Nous offrons à nos joueurs une expérience exceptionnelle, à la fois technique, créative et qualitative. Innovation, unité et appartenance : nos valeurs façonnent une culture d’entreprise multiculturelle et unique.   Et si tu avais un futur dans le jeu ?   Techniquement, Winamax c’est : Un moteur de jeu puissant et innovant : adaptation dynamique de l'offre de jeu, parties de poker hautement configurables, détection de fraude Une architecture distribuée et scalable conçue pour traiter en temps réel les flux de la plateforme Une plateforme modulaire soumise à des contraintes de haute disponibilité et de sécurisation des données, capable de gérer de fortes audience Contexte Nos mini-jeux reposent sur la même logique de fond : une session courte, une animation qui doit rester fluide du début à la fin, un résultat traçable et auditable par le régulateur. Chaque nouveau mini jeu repart pourtant de zéro, alors que l'essentiel est commun.   Comment concevoir un socle générique qui permette d'en sortir un nouveau en quelques semaines, sans rien céder ni sur la fluidité ni sur l'auditabilité ? Objectifs du stage Concevoir le template générique et les API associées : cycle de vie d'une session, actions du joueur, résultats Développer le socle d'interface à partir des maquettes UX/UI : L'enjeu visuel est central : chaque mini jeu doit donner envie d'y jouer rien qu'en le regardant Rédiger la documentation, puis passer le test grandeur nature : produire un premier mini jeu sur ce socle et le faire auditer. Les impératifs à prendre en compte pour ce sujet : les exigences du régulateur, la forte volumétrie, et la faible latence nécessaire au plaisir du jeu.  Stack technique Frontend : React, TypeScript Backend : JavaScript, API JSON-RPC Infrastructure : AWS, Redis, MySQL Modalités du stage Stage de fin d'études (Master 2) à pourvoir à temps plein uniquement à Paris, France Opportunité de CDI à la fin du stage Rémunération : 30k POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ?   En plus de notre univers poker et paris sportifs, nous avons d’autres avantages !   Une culture d’entreprise multiculturelle et unique  Une semaine de travail en 4 jours Opportunité de CDI si tu as atteint les objectifs du stage Coaching de tes soft skills avec les Cours Florent Un cadre de travail convivial, en plein cœur de Paris (rooftop tour Eiffel, salle de jeux vidéo et salle de sport…) Une vie d’entreprise riche avec des soirées et événements organisés régulièrement (tournois de poker, soirées thématiques, barbecues tout l'été…) Des primes d’intéressement et de participation si tu restes parmi nous à l'issue de ton stage Un accès au programme de cooptation (bonus de cooptation jusqu’à 5000 €) Un restaurant d’entreprise Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Because you are present in the queue every day, you will develop a sharp eye for recurring friction. Alongside daily ticket resolution, you will raise concrete bugs to engineering, contribute to internal documentation, and help refine our AI-driven support tooling over time. Raise Issues to Engineering & Product: Flag recurring user friction, document edge cases with clear reproduction steps, and surface bugs directly to engineering. Improve Support Operations: Suggest practical tweaks to our support workflow and test internal AI tooling to help resolve routine questions faster. You Might Be a Fit If… You have genuine excitement for front-line support: you take pride in helping customers, write with patience and clarity, and enjoy working through an active ticket queue. You are available to start ASAP for a 6-month full-time internship, working 100% on-site from our Berlin office. You have strong systems thinking and an analytical drive: you like breaking down tricky technical or operational problems logically and figuring out what’s actually happening under the hood. You demonstrate high agency and end-to-end ownership: you take responsibility for tickets from start to resolution, diagnosing root causes so the same issues don't keep repeating. You have deep curiosity for applied AI and tooling: you love experimenting with new models, automations, and modern tools, and naturally look for ways technology can streamline work. Technical or analytical background (plus): studies or hands-on experience in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a track record of building technical projects. You communicate clearly and professionally in both German and English. You are a kind person who cares about the people around you. The Environment We work from our office in Berlin, Greifswalder Strasse 212. Everyone works together in person because the hardest problems get solved faster at a whiteboard than in a Slack thread. Health is not separate from work here, it is part of how we work well. The vibe is calm but intense. No one is yelling or panicking. But everyone is working hard on things that matter. Compensation

jobs.title: Senior Embedded (ARM) Engineer - Quantum Computing (m/w/d)
jobs.description: eleQtron develops and operates full-stack quantum computers based on trapped-ion technology. Quantum computing is a new computing paradigm rapidly approaching commercial viability. stack, so experiments defined in software run correctly on the machine Required Skills: 5+ years of professional embedded software development for real-time or timing-critical systems Deep command of schematics and datasheets, and debugging real hardware with oscilloscopes, logic analysers, and JTAG Strong grasp of real-time concepts: interrupts, DMA, timing, concurrency, and determinism A track jobs.description: ABOUT MORE IN COMMON LOCATION: London (Monday-Thursday in the office, Friday remote) CONTRACT: Full-time SALARY: £36,000-£46,000 START DATE: As soon as possible More in Common is a research agency working across the US, UK, Germany, France, Spain and Poland to tackle polarisation and division. More in Common leads and supports initiatives to build more united, inclusive, and resilient societies. Our mission is to understand the forces driving us apart, help societies find common ground and bring people together to tackle shared challenges. In the UK, our work is best described as being part consultancy and part think tank. We provide a full suite of research services including polling and focus group research; evidence reviews and secondary data analysis; audience mapping and audience strategy; strategic communications strategy and campaign development. More in Common are members of the British Polling Council. Our work is informed by our ground-breaking segmentation of the British public. This unique values-based lens to our quantitative and qualitative research means we can understand not only what the public thinks of the big challenges facing British society today – but crucially why they think it. Our insights help leaders in government, the media, business, and civil society to develop better strategies and communications – particularly in reaching disengaged communities far from the Westminster/London bubble – and to better navigate tricky and divisive issues. Over the last year, More in Common has published agenda-setting thought leadership on a whole range of debates facing British society – including exploring the public’s starting points on assisted dying and immigration; understanding how the British public is navigating major debates from trans and gender identity to the conflict in Israel and Palestine; and our political research has helped policymakers and politicians understand the dramatic fragmentation of our politics. Our work is regularly covered in the British press and media and we’ve developed a series of partnerships with broadcasters and newspapers to deliver top-quality research insights. In the 2024 General Election, we were among Britain’s most accurate pollsters and used our focus group research to put people and public opinion at the centre of coverage of the election campaign. Through our consultancy, More in Common has also supported dozens of partners with insights and strategic communications support. We’ve helped national institutions such as the BBC, British Library and National Trust to better understand their audiences, we’ve helped partners in government and civil society with the set-up and delivery of the Homes for Ukraine scheme, and we’ve supported a range of partners to test their policy proposals from the National Farmers Union to Rethink Mental Illness among many others. More in Common has a range of exciting projects in the pipeline, including: Understanding the key dynamics of public attitudes to climate change and the energy transition. Exploring public opinion on immigration, integration and multiculturalism. Embedding our new Seven Segments with a wider range of organisations, including developing new products and trainings to help people understand the segments. Helping navigate declining trust in institutions, for example exploring why trust in universities and science appears to be falling. ABOUT THIS ROLE More in Common is seeking a Senior Research Associate to deliver high-quality research projects. They will work across our core areas of research for clients, media and communications, political polling and partnerships. More in Common UK is a small team with a start-up culture where everyone is expected to execute a range of responsibilities. The role will be based in our London office Monday-Thursday with Friday at the office or working at home. jobs.description: <p><strong>Staff Software Engineer</strong><strong><br></strong>London, UK</p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>Applied Intelligence Systems (AIS) is part of the Scale Generative AI Platform (SGP), focused on pushing the frontier of what agentic applications can do across diverse enterprise and government use cases. We build the infrastructure and tooling that power agentic AI in production, paired with applied ML research, design, and evaluation to ensure these systems perform reliably at the scale our customers demand. AIS spans multiple workstreams — agent evaluation and oversight, orchestration and tool-use infrastructure, model and systems optimization, and applied research on new agent capabilities. This role owns the context and memory capabilities within AIS, including their correctness, performance, and evaluation.&nbsp;</p> <p>We are looking for a Staff Engineer who can own hard technical problems end to end, from the software systems that serve context to agents through to the evaluation choices that determine whether that context is actually useful. This role suits someone comfortable moving between distributed systems engineering and applied ML, because the team is built the same way, with software engineers and ML engineers working the same roadmap rather than two separate tracks.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own large, ambiguous problems in context and memory end to end, from design through production, including the backend systems, the retrieval and memory algorithms, and the evaluation that proves they work.</li> <li>Architect the core primitives that let agents retrieve, store, and reason over long-running and cross-session context, including knowledge base retrieval, vector stores, and memory strategies.</li> <li>Design and maintain the evaluation methodology for memory and retrieval quality, including the rubrics and benchmarks that catch regressions before customers do.</li> <li>Set technical standards that other engineers on the team adopt, whether that is an architectural pattern, an eval practice, or an approach to failure handling under partial system failure.</li> <li>Partner with SWE and MLE peers on the same roadmap, and coordinate with AIS's other workstreams (orchestration, evaluation and oversight, systems optimisation) where memory and context intersect their scope.</li> <li>Debug and resolve the most severe production issues tied to context and memory, including incorrect retrieval, stale or leaked context across tenants, and degraded relevance at scale.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we look for</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of engineering experience, with a multi-year track record owning production systems end to end, not just implementing scoped work handed to you by another team.</li> <li>Direct experience with the ML and information retrieval problems underneath modern AI systems, such as embeddings, vector search, retrieval augmented generation, fine-tuning, or agent memory architectures, and the judgement to choose between them for a given problem.</li> <li>Comfort owning both sides of the stack. You do not need to be equally deep in both software engineering and applied ML, but you need enough range in each to make good calls without waiting for a specialist.</li> <li>Proficiency in Python, and experience with the infrastructure that production ML and agentic systems run on (containers, cloud platforms, and CI/CD).</li> <li>Track record of setting technical standards that outlived the project they were built for, and of influencing decisions beyond your own team through design reviews, technical writing, or direct mentorship of software and ML engineers.</li> <

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Identity
jobs.description: <p>Software is eating the world, but AI is eating software. We live in unprecedented times – AI has the potential to exponentially augment human intelligence. Every person will have a personal tutor, coach, assistant, personal shopper, travel guide, and therapist throughout life. As the world adjusts to this new reality, leading platform companies are scrambling to build LLMs at billion scale, while large enterprises figure out how to add it to their products. To make them safe, aligned and actually useful, these models need human eval and reinforcement learning through human feedback (RLHF) during pre-training, fine-tuning, and production evaluations. This is the main innovation that’s enabled ChatGPT to get such a large headstart among competition.</p> <p>At Scale, our products include the Generative AI Data Engine, SGP, Donovan, and others that power the most advanced LLMs and generative models in the world through world-class RLHF, human data generation, model evaluation, safety, and alignment. The data we are producing is some of the most important work for how humanity will interact with AI.</p> <p>At the foundation of these products is the Identity&nbsp; Engineering team.&nbsp; In this role, you will help support the design and development of core software systems specifically focused on identity, access management, authorization, and authentication.&nbsp; You’ll also get widespread exposure to the forefront of the AI race as Scale sees it in enterprises, startups, governments, and large tech companies.</p> <p>You will:</p> <ul> <li>Drive the design, and implementation of our identity infrastructure to ensure secure authentication and authorization across enterprise systems.</li> <li>Build software for authentication mechanisms such as Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>ABOUT QUINCE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes&nbsp; and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.</p> <p>What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>OUR CULTURE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.</p> <ul> <li>We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.&nbsp; Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.</li> <li>Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.&nbsp;</li> <li>Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.</p></div><h4><strong>Role Overview</strong></h4> <p>We're looking for a Senior Inventory Planner to own product launch planning and post-launch replenishment execution for Quince's UK and EU expansion. This is not a steady-state replen role. It's the planner who decides how deep we go on new products at launch, then operates the day-to-day to make sure those products actually land on time and scale well.</p> <p>You'll size initial launch buys for products dropping into the UK and EU at a weekly cadence, often with little or no local demand history, by triangulating from Quince overall performance, comparable products, comparable markets, lead-time realities, and informed judgement. Once products are live, you'll act on early sell-through signals and trigger replenishment decisions fast, pulling forward, doubling down on winners, cutting losses on losers, and adjusting the next launch wave based on what the market is teaching us.</p> <p>This role sits at the heart of Quince's International expansion. You'll take that and run it, across our website, social, events, launches and our flagship conference. Where you see something that should be better, you'll be trusted to make it better. You'll sit day-to-day in Marketing and be part of the wider Design team, alongside experienced Product Designers who'll be on hand to partner on web-native work. What you’ll be doing Own brand design across all touchpoints - website, social, ads, guides, reports, events and swag - keeping quality and consistency high through a busy launch and campaign calendar. Design and roll out launch creative for product launches, including launch video animation and campaign assets, partnering with Product Designers on product-screen work. Be an advocate for consistency and craft as we scale and grow the incident.io brand. Partner with the marketing team on both tactical and long-term projects, while bringing your own perspective on how we should develop our brand. Collaborate with the wider design team as we know an amazing product is the foundation for a great brand, and compelling design can be the foundation for both. What you need to be successful A portfolio showcasing exceptional brand and marketing design work , with proven experience creating high-impact, exciting websites, LinkedIn campaigns, guides, and presentations, while maintaining meticulous attention to detail. We want everything we put out in the world - from compelling swag, to tight one-pagers event materials - to be well crafted and as good as it can be. Experience working closely with frontend engineers to translate your designs into reality, sweating the details and getting hands on to tweak the HTML/CSS where required A highly collaborative mindset demonstrated through proactive sharing of work-in-progress designs, and thoughtful incorporation of feedback. An organised, pragmatic streak since startups can (occasionally!) be chaotic. You’re able to figure things out when faced with ambiguity. Comfort picking up an established brand and extending it with judgement, rather than needing to rebuild from first principles. This is the main difference from the original Brand Designer brief. Bonus points You have experience with motion design / animation You have experience designing booths and installations for conferences and events You've covered a role on an FTC or contract basis before and know how to get productive fast Supporting you We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. What that looks like day to day As an Expansion Account Manager at incident.io , you're picking up the relationship with companies like Vanta, Linear and Vercel - the ones who started small and won't stay that size for long. You own a book of commercial customers end to end, and your job is simple to say and hard to do: keep them, and grow them. jobs.title: Junior Product Owner
jobs.description: Your journey ROMEO is the queer company behind the legendary ROMEO dating app, one of Europe’s longest-standing dating platforms for queer communities. We are looking for a Product Owner to join our Product team in Berlin and help shape how ideas and product requirements make their way into the hands of millions of users. In this delivery-focused role, you will work closely with Product Management, Design, Engineering, QA and BI to turn product priorities into clear, actionable work for our development teams. It is a great opportunity to grow your product skills while taking real ownership of the day-to-day delivery process. Your typical day Support the Product Management team in refining product requirements and translating approved PRDs into implementation-ready epics, user stories and tickets. Ensure user stories have clear acceptance criteria and are sufficiently refined before entering development. Maintain and order the backlog according to priorities set by product leadership. Take part in regular and ad hoc meetings to clarify product requirements with development, design and other delivery teams. Support our two-week delivery cycle by ensuring development teams have the information and decisions they need to proceed. Identify missing requirements, dependencies, open decisions and blockers early, and escalate them to Product or Delivery. Work closely with QA to communicate product and release priorities, clarify acceptance criteria, and support defect triage and release-readiness decisions. Support product acceptance and release readiness by checking delivered functionality against agreed requirements and acceptance criteria. Support the BI team by translating product questions, KPIs and tracking needs into clear data requirements. Ensure agreed analytics requirements are captured as part of delivery, including relevant event tracking before work is considered complete. Maintain clear and up-to-date product documentation in Jira and Confluence. We look for You are passionate about building products for LGBTQ+ communities and interested in contributing to the continued development of ROMEO. You have initial experience in a Product Owner or similar product delivery role, ideally in a B2C environment. Experience in social, dating or community products is a plus. Being familiar with how our product works is a plus. You have experience writing or refining user stories and acceptance criteria. You have a good understanding of Agile product development and ideally hands-on experience with Scrum and/or Kanban. You are comfortable working with Jira and Confluence. Experience with Xray is a plus. You are organised, detail-oriented and reliable in following work through to completion. You proactively follow up on missing information and drive requirements towards clarity. You are based in Berlin or willing to relocate and are happy to work from our Wittenbergplatz office at least three days per week. You have excellent written and spoken English skills, ideally at a native or near-native level. What We Offer A hands-on role working on an established European digital product during a significant phase of product and technology transformation. Close collaboration with Product, Design, Engineering, QA and BI, Hybrid working (3 days per week in our Berlin office at Wittenbergplatz) €40 employer contribution towards the Germany Job Ticket EGYM Wellpass (only €20/month employee contribution) In-house German classes Annual learning budget (e.g. for conferences, courses, certifications) International team, English-speaking environment Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Sie gehören außerdem zu den ersten Praktikern in Europa, die mit einem domänenspezifischen KI-Modell arbeiten, das vollständig auf Maschinenkonformität trainiert wurde. Im Gegenzug erhalten Sie frühen Zugang zu einem Werkzeug, das Ihnen einen messbaren Vorteil gegenüber jedem anderen Berater in Ihrem Markt verschafft. Aufgaben Ihre Aufgaben Echte Kundenprojekte auf CE-Scan durchführen und strukturiertes Feedback zu jedem Aspekt des Workflows, der KI-Ergebnisse und der exportierten Berichte geben. Uns helfen zu verstehen, wo die Plattform Zeit spart und wo sie noch Reibungspunkte erzeugt, damit wir diese vor dem Launch beheben können. CE-Scan Kunden vorstellen, die sich auf den Übergang zur Maschinenverordnung 2027 vorbereiten, und ihnen helfen, ihre ersten Projekte auf der Plattform durchzuführen. Die regulatorische Genauigkeit der Mini-Modell-Ausgaben während des Trainingsfortschritts bewerten, basierend auf Ihrem eigenen Wissen über die Richtlinie, die Verordnung und die harmonisierten Normen. Fundierte Kenntnisse der technischen Dokumentationsstruktur, der Risikobeurteilung nach EN ISO 12100, der harmonisierten Normen und des Konformitätsbewertungsverfahrens. Das professionelle Ansehen, CE-Scan glaubwürdig gegenüber mittelständischen Herstellern und großen Industriekunden zu vertreten. jobs.description: 🏆 What's the opportunity? Air freight carries less than 1% of world trade by volume and more than a third of it by value, around $22.7 billion of goods every single day. It's how a vaccine reaches a clinic before it spoils, how a semiconductor arrives before the production line stops, and how a retailer restocks a continent away in three days instead of five weeks. When speed is the whole point, freight flies. Somebody has to price it, book it and move it, and that work is still done largely by hand, in inboxes and spreadsheets. For eight years we've been building the data infrastructure underneath it: direct integrations with 75 airlines, the top ten ocean carriers and dozens of GSAs, used every day by 30,000 freight forwarders across 172 countries to hold their rates, price their business and book their freight. In 2026 we acquired Cargofive, and cargo.one now spans air and ocean, the two modes that carry international trade. That foundation is what makes the next part possible. In March 2026 we launched the industry's first AI-native operating system for multimodal freight:one workspace where freight teams and AI agents work side by side across rate management, procurement, quoting, booking and support. Crane Worldwide and Yusen Logistics are rolling it out across their global operations. AI-led engineering is how we build. Engineers write specs and acceptance criteria, agents do much of the implementation, and the engineer owns the architecture, the review and what ships. We're backed by Index Ventures, Bessemer, Creandum, Point Nine, Next47 and Lufthansa Cargo, which has been an investor in us since 2018. 🚀 What makes this role different This is an engineering management job for a team where agents do much of the implementation. That changes the job. When producing code gets cheaper and faster, the bottleneck moves. Throughput depends more on how well engineers define the problem, direct the agents, review what comes back and tell a plausible answer from a correct one. You'll lead our engineers: what they ship, how good it is, how fast they move, whether the people are growing, and how quickly the team gets better at working AI-led. A lot of what engineering managers know about pacing, estimating, reviewing and measuring a team was calibrated for a different bottleneck. Working out what good looks like now is part of this job. Today, engineers direct agents on their own work. That's where we are, but it's not the end state. We're building toward fleets of agents that work on their own inside guardrails and harnesses we design, while engineers move up to setting direction, reviewing what comes back, and owning what ships. Part of your job is helping the team get there while keeping the quality bar high . This is also a player-coach role. You'll stay close enough to the code to keep your judgment sharp and your technical credibility current, while the engineers you lead and what they deliver remain the focus. 🧭 What we're looking for — the part that isn't negotiable You get more from growing people than from being the smartest person in the room. You've watched someone you managed become better than you at something and enjoyed it. You run real one-to-ones, not status meetings. You give hard feedback early and kindly, and you've done the hard version more than once. You think in systems. Teams are systems too. You can see why delivery is slipping without needing someone to tell you, and you fix the process rather than working harder inside a broken one. You're excited about the business. You want to know what your engineers' work is worth and what it does for the customer paying us. You can explain that to them so their work has a point beyond the issue they're closing. jobs.title: Senior Legal Counsel – Contracts (German speaker)
jobs.description: Could your legal expertise help build the contractual foundations of Europe’s next financial management platform? At Pennylane, we believe legal should be more than a safeguard. It should be a business enabler. Our ambition is to equip millions of small and medium-sized businesses across Europe with a complete, high-performing financial management platform. As Pennylane continues to grow rapidly in France and expand internationally, we are looking for a Senior Legal Counsel, Contracts to join our Legal, Compliance & Risk team. Within a Legal department of 10 professionals, the Contracts team secures Pennylane’s commercial and operational relationships with customers, suppliers, partner firms, resellers, integrators and strategic partners. Reporting to the Lead Legal Counsel, Contracts , you will work closely with our Sales, Partnerships, Security, Finance and Product teams. This is a hands-on role where legal rigor, creativity and business pragmatism are equally valued. 🌍 What is Pennylane? Pennylane is one of France’s most dynamic fintech companies, currently expanding rapidly across Europe. In just six years, we have managed to: 💻 Establish ourselves in the market as an innovative provider of accounting and financial management software 💰 Raise a total of €400 million from renowned investors, including Sequoia, Silicon Valley’s leading venture capital firm, known for backing Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, PayPal, and many others in their early days 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 co-founders to a team of 1,000 employees, with an average Glassdoor rating of 4.9/5 and 94% of reviewers saying they would recommend Pennylane to their friends and family 🌍 Build an international team made up of employees from 25 different countries, with a truly flexible remote-working culture 🚀 More than 900,000 small and medium-sized businesses and over 6,000 accounting firms in France already use Pennylane! 🎯 Your role You will act as a trusted legal partner for teams across Pennylane, managing a broad range of commercial and operational agreements from drafting through to signature and post-signature follow-up. You will also help make our contracting processes more efficient and scalable, contributing to the tools, templates, playbooks and legal culture that support Pennylane’s growth. 📋 Your responsibilities International contracts Draft and negotiate purchase orders and related agreements with partner firms, primarily outside France, with a current focus on Germany. Manage contracts with strategic international suppliers. Maintain and improve templates in line with regulatory, product and business developments. Work with Sales and Partnerships to streamline the contracting process. Customer, reseller and integrator agreements Improve customer terms and conditions for SME customers across France and Europe. Support Sales with the contracting process and automated quotations. Review and negotiate agreements with Pennylane integrators and resellers. Anticipate the contractual impact of key regulations, including e-invoicing, payment services and the EU AI Act. Contribute to contract templates and playbooks. Legal operations and collaboration Structure and improve internal contracting processes to increase efficiency and scalability. Optimize our contract management tools, including Tomorro, Pivot and Notion. Identify opportunities to automate repetitive, low-value tasks, including through AI. Provide clear, pragmatic advice to Sales, Partnerships, Finance, Security and Product teams. Train non-legal teams and help build a strong legal culture across Pennylane. 🙋 The profile we are looking for You are a qualified lawyer or legal counsel with extensive experience in contract law, gained in a law firm, particularly in IP/IT, technology or SaaS, and/or in a fast-growing tech company. You are fluent in English and have a working knowledge of Franch and German. You have strong expertise in B2B SaaS agreements , including IP, indemnification, liability caps

jobs.title: Finanz- und Digitalisierungsberatung (w/m/d) - Accounting & Taxation

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: YOUR MISSION A software engineer today uses Claude Code or Cursor. A mechanical engineer designing the next jet engine still searches Excel sheets and asks whoever has been around longest. We are building the AI co-engineer for physical products: one that works natively in 3D and learns from real engineering decisions. We are in production with major European manufacturers, with real revenue and customers who tell us when we are slow. The problems are open ones. Getting an agent to reason usefully about geometry, making 3D search work on real customer part libraries, and figuring out what the interface even looks like when an engineer asks why a bracket failed. There is research to borrow from and very little product to copy. Senior or staff level depending on experience. WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON You will own large problems end to end, across the stack. We cannot say exactly what that looks like in month three, but here is what the last two years have actually involved. A multi-agent orchestration SDK , built from scratch . Nothing off the shelf handled what we needed: long-horizon execution that runs for hours and survives restarts. CAD conversion as a real pipeline . It used to be manual and brittle. Turning it into production infrastructure meant writing a Python wrapper around a C++ SDK and making it reliable enough to sit under everything else. Migrating the application off Electron and Webpack onto SSR React with Vite . That architecture is what the whole product now sits on. What is coming: 3D-to-3D search across real customer part libraries, not benchmark datasets Constraint solvers and optimization , and getting an agent to use one sensibly Agents that hold a useful model of a physical object , which is still an open problem Hybrid cloud deployments for manufacturers who cannot send their data anywhere We work in Python and TypeScript, with multi-agent orchestration and AI integrations across several providers. jobs.title: Founding Legal Engineer
jobs.description: About Grubel Grubel is a research lab that builds AI for high-stakes knowledge work, starting with law. Legal matters require specialized expertise, and each one involves its own facts, practices, parties, and institutions. General-purpose AI applies the same system to every legal matter, varying only what goes into a limited context window. To meet the depth and diversity of legal work, we let every matter build its own AI: engineer the right data for the matter, adapt the model and agent to it, and track what improves. We combine the three into a matter-specific improvement loop that runs until the system delivers what the matter demands. Grubel was founded in 2026 by Moritz Hardt, director at the Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems and formerly a UC Berkeley professor and Google Brain researcher; and Reinhard Heckel, professor of machine learning at the Technical University of Munich, on leave to build Grubel. The founding team includes engineers with PhDs in computer science and experience in foundation-model pretraining at Mistral and legal AI research at Thomson Reuters. The lab has offices in Munich and Tübingen. Point Nine led an oversubscribed pre-seed funding round with backing from leading AI researchers and founders, including Jeff Dean, Chris Ré, Ion Stoica, and Harvey co-founders Gabe Pereyra and Winston Weinberg. About the role You are a skilled lawyer ideally with experience on building legal AI software eager to shape the technological future of your field. As a Founding Legal Engineer, you impact how we scope, build, and evaluate AI systems for complex legal work, and how these systems enter legal practice. Working directly with Grubel’s founding team, you will shape our research, development, and product: Translate complex legal processes into agentic workflows, evaluate our systems for legal soundness and utility, and work with customers to set our product and engineering standards. You need not write code, but you’re passionate about understanding our technology deeply. Working in a fast-moving team at the intersection of AI research, legal practice, and technology excites you. What you’ll work on Designing realistic tasks, datasets, and evaluation rubrics for training and evaluation of our legal AI systems Translating complex legal processes into agentic workflows together with our researchers and engineers Evaluating system outputs for legal accuracy, usefulness, and failure modes Leading enterprise pilots and implementations Supporting customer discovery, demonstrations, and go-to-market initiatives You may be a good fit if You have law degree and strong academic record You have experience practicing law—whether at a law firm, in-house, or in another legal setting You are proactive, self-directed, and comfortable taking broad ownership at an early-stage company You are curious about how AI systems work and comfortable working closely with researchers and engineers Logistics Munich or Tübingen. We value working together in person, prefer candidates based near one of our offices, and expect at least one day per week in the office. We plan to establish a Zurich office in 2027.
